# Interface and storage instructions
Mobile-first 320px and accessible semantic HTML; keyboard focus and WCAG 2.2 AA. Plain language and restrained premium branding. No backend calls, automatic sharing, PII in URLs or hidden telemetry. Browser storage may throw and should gracefully fail. Results remain available without any contact sharing; label print/save-as-PDF accurately.
